pages.text: During playtime, the class is asked to build one giant cardboard train.
They choose team jobs: cutters, tapers, painters, and decorators.
Nia asks, What color should our train be? Everyone shares ideas.
The team votes for red with yellow stars.
Kai tapes the wheels while Rina paints the windows.
When tape tears, a friend says, Try again, I can hold this side.
Soon the train has doors, seats, and a paper bell.
Each child adds one final detail before the parade.
They pull the train together around the room, laughing.
The class learns teamwork makes big projects possible and fun.
